name: Is inspection coordination support included in your general contracting services, or is it an add-on?

mainEntity.name: Is inspection coordination support included in your general contracting services, or is it an add-on?

acceptedAnswer.text: At City Dweller, LLC, inspection coordination support is typically integrated as a core component of our comprehensive general contracting services. We view it as essential for successful project delivery and compliance. The specifics of its inclusion and any associated costs will be clearly outlined in your project proposal and contract. We believe that transparent and professional management of inspections is a fundamental part of providing a complete and reliable service, ensuring your project progresses smoothly from start to finish without hidden charges for essential compliance tasks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Inspection coordination support is generally included as a core part of City Dweller, LLC's comprehensive general contracting services, with details outlined in your project proposal.
